input_protocol: P5 explicitly permits all26274 objects' geometry/type/name. Whitelist id,map_name,name,object_type,contour,position,dimension; descriptions and all target keys forbidden. IDs for association only, no learned ID/map embeddings. Distinct from old named-landmark A0 protocol.
population: Existing P2 Train256/InternalDev128/Seen128 independent families, one maximum causal cutoff selected by public timestamps. Original 28x28 grid and20m XY radius. Train/Dev disjoint maps and objects. Raw full instruction only: processed reference-name labels prohibited for new inference.

graph.road_connectivity: touching road surfaces at same approximate level only; unverified vehicle routing

language: Conservative entity/relation parser. Between is a joint ternary factor, distinct anchors, marginalize hypotheses. Relative left/right/front/behind retain frame ambiguity. Unknown colors never inferred from private object descriptions.
heatmap: Object polygon/boundary kernel marginal plus continuous relation field; mixture with original A0 probabilities. All original784 candidate cells retained. This is a new posterior interface, not an increase of old Residual Gain.

development.selection: Internal Dev Goal R1, then lower damage, then smaller mixture; no Seen search
development.gate: best A2 vs A0 >=1pp, paired map95CI lower>0 and Recovery>Damage before GAT training

gat.control: matched trained no-message head, same language/node features/subgraph/train steps; retain all outside-subgraph object posterior mass
gat.train_loss: multi-positive <=20m Goal NLL; target ID/coordinates only sealed supervision

rgb: Implement causal polygon ROI, eroded foreground, HSV/Lab and cached frozen visual vector/phrase interfaces. No encoding or training before geometry stages support continuation. Observed-only updates; unknown has zero evidence. Black/Shuffled preserve polygons,candidates,quality and timestamps. No unobserved negatives.
seen: One frozen final configuration run; includes A0/A1/A2 and only stages legitimately reached. No Seen model/hyperparameter selection.
oracle: Offline GT identity selects a public object's geometry for upper-bound diagnosis only. GT coordinate grid coverage diagnostic separate. No GT normal forward path. Reference relation truth unavailable remains null, no target-nearest anchor labels.

budget.closedloop: only Seen localization/safety passes; existing controller/protocol preserved

stop: No stage benefit => stop corresponding training, preserve complete code and negative results. Failed localization gate => no navigation/Unseen. No GAT depth or ResidualGain search.
